author: musho7-dev
subject: Fix suspension: wheels sat fully pushed up into the body
body:
Springs were far too soft, so every car rested with its wheels at the
top of their travel (100% sag): bodies sat on the tires and wheels
looked sunk into the arches. Spring stiffness is now computed from the
car's weight and the planet's gravity and pre-loaded, so at rest the
wheels sit where the art expects (0-1 px off) with travel left for
bumps. Shocks upgrade now stiffens springs by 6% per level.
